title: 黛安娜·月窗插花
description: 银白发黛安娜穿完整月纹衣甲，在月形窗边插一枝小花，弧刃静靠墙边。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Diana is an adult silver-haired Lunari woman with pale skin, intense light eyes, and a crescent-shaped forehead mark. Preserve her curved silver armor details and dark blue-purple lunar palette through a fully covering high-neck tunic, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Her large crescent blade rests safely in a shaped floor stand, keeping its recognizable silhouette without an attack pose.
art_direction.scene: She stands beside a low table beneath a crescent-shaped window and places one pale flower into a small ceramic vase. A soft curtain and a folded cloth are the only other room details. Her free hand gently steadies the vase, and her thoughtful face looks quietly pleased while the blade remains still at the wall.
art_direction.palette: silver white, midnight blue, pale lilac, soft gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
